other_conditions: Applicant must be a small or marginal farmer
Applicant must be a ‘Raiyat’ or ‘Bataidaar’ farmer
Applicant must have a valid Aadhaar Number
Applicant must possess requisite land papers (LPC/Land Receipts)
Farmers cultivating on government or non‑majorua land with lease or settlement documents from the Revenue Department are eligible
Crop assistance is available for agricultural land between a minimum of 10 decimals and a maximum of 5 acres
Crop loss must be at least 20% to qualify for assistance
Scheme is voluntary for all farmers
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹3,000 per acre for 30‑50% crop loss or ₹4,000 per acre for >50% loss, applicable for up to 5 acres.
documents_required: Lease or settlement documents from Revenue Department
